verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents using MCP servers as a knowledge *source* (client role, coderabbit-docs-12) to pull context from docs/design/PM tools, but there is no evidence CodeRabbit itself exposes an official MCP server that external agents could connect to and drive its review capabilities. As a SaaS platform, this axis is plausible, but no server-side MCP endpoint is documented.
